items.text: If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.
items.author: Steve Jobs

items.text: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
items.author: Nelson Mandela

items.text: Sometimes things aren't clear right away. That's where you need to be patient and persevere and see where things lead.
items.author: Mary Pierce

items.text: The best revenge is not to be like your enemy.
items.author: Marcus Aurelius

items.text: In the long-run (and often in the short-run), your willpower will never beat your environment. The more disciplined your environment is, the less disciplined you need to be. Don't swim upstream.
items.author: James Clear, Atomic Habits

items.text: Things that have never happened before happen all the time.
items.author: Morgan Housel

items.text: Some people are born into families that encourage education; others are against it. Some are born into flourishing economies encouraging of entrepreneurship; others are born into war and destitution. I want you to be successful, and I want you to earn it. But realize that not all success is due to hard work, and not all poverty is due to laziness. Keep this in mind when judging people, including yourself.
items.author: Morgan Housel, The Psychology of Money
